Author: ocealot
Name: AureliusJobBars
Description:
Additional job gauges, party buff timers, mitigation trackers, and more. Icon by PAPACHIN

Fork of 0ceal0t/JobBars: native action tooltips when hovering Buffs/Cooldowns icons, and cooldowns hidden until the party member's level unlocks them. Toggles in /jobbars.
Punchline: Extra job gauges, with native action tooltips on hover
Changelog: Tooltips now fire - they had to be set on the component's CollisionNode, since SimpleOverlayNode zeroes its flags and NodeBase skips ComponentNodes when applying HasCollision. Also hides cooldowns above the party member's level (Action.ClassJobLevel). Both toggleable in /jobbars.
